_meta.description: Zerodha Kite Connect read-only MarketDataProvider (R4 / DD-1). Secrets stay in .env (KITE_API_KEY, KITE_ACCESS_TOKEN). Default ingestion.provider remains 'file' until you flip config.
_meta.symbols_note: Intentionally empty. Every real ingest path passes an explicit symbol scope (owner candidates), which replaces this list. A non-empty value here would silently narrow an unscoped run — it previously held ['INFY'], which would have collapsed the universe to one stock. An unscoped run now raises in KiteProvider rather than guessing a universe; callers that genuinely want the whole catalogue pass allow_full_catalog=True.
